hero.caption:
This flag was made by Juan Bautista Alvarado in 1837. It was carried into the Battle of San Buenaventura and later flown over the church after the affair.
The flag was described as: "...With such a plan in mind I had a Mexican flag brought to my room and on the white part of the banner in letter printed with a brush I wrote the words: Independence for California..."-Rosie & the Bear Flag, page 9.
